visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with black hair sits in a car's passenger seat, wearing a black jacket over a striped shirt. A female hand enters the frame holding a red "NBA All-Star Danglers" mystery pack. The background shows a gas station exterior with Shell signage visible through the car window. Lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The boy points at the packaging, indicating his choice. The hand holding the camera moves closer to the pack to show details of the characters like LeBron James and Steph Curry. The boy's facial expression is curious and engaged. The car interior is clean and modern. (3) The boy uses both hands to tear open the red plastic packaging. He looks focused, with a slight smile on his face. The camera stays in a medium close-up, capturing the physical movement of the hands and the rustling of the plastic bag against his lap. (4) The boy pulls out a yellow plush keychain of Ja Morant. He smiles broadly, displaying high excitement. The camera zooms in slightly on the keychain held by the boy, then the female hand takes it to show the back side with a logo. (5) A second red mystery pack is introduced. The boy points to another character on the back of the package while looking at the camera. He seems even more excited than before. The hand holding the pack shifts its angle to catch the light properly. (6) The boy tears open the second pack with rapid movements. He reveals a grey plush keychain of Victor Wembanyama. He laughs hysterically and leans back, his body shaking with joy. The camera captures his wide-open mouth and squinted eyes as he celebrates his luck.
